answer: Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through a prism debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the canyon totals, and the ember anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 39 units per epoch, sustaining 25 aliases for 19 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. That is 24 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
